title: Walsh average of the polynomial generator
statement: Let $\ell>0$, and let a monic polynomial over $\mathbb F_2$ of degree $\ell$ be irreducible. For $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $r\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$, average the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ over the generator outputs obtained by choosing $s$ uniformly from $\mathbb F_2^\ell$. This average is $1$ if the sum of the vectors $\gamma_i r^{i+1}$ in $\mathbb F_2^\ell$ is zero, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: the degree-$\ell$ monic modulus is irreducible
